item.title: Rainfall Advisory No. 3 #NCRPRSD
item.description:
Rainfall Advisory No. 3 #NCR_PRSD
Weather System: Shear Line
Issued at: 8:00 AM, 28 October 2026(Wednesday)

Light to moderate with occasional heavy rains are expected over Batangas(San Juan, Lobo, Rosario, Taysan, Padre Garcia).

Light to moderate with occasional heavy rains affecting Quezon(San Francisco, Mulanay, San Andres, Jomalig, Patnanungan, Burdeos, San Narciso, Panukulan, Catanauan, Lopez, Macalelon, General Luna, Buenavista, Guinayangan, Tagkawayan, Calauag) and may affect nearby areas.

The public and the Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Offices concerned are advised to MONITOR the weather condition and watch for the next warning to be issued at 11:00 AM today.
For more information and queries, please call telephone numbers 8927-1335 and 8927-2877 or log on to www.pagasa.dost.gov.ph.
